source: 54 full v1 vs live Master3s2 tapes from v1_phase_census/latest_games.json. Full scored 14-game 4a4677c9 archived ladder appendix, both focal observer seats, evaluation only. Require distinct terrain and seed across maps and no overlap between original/ladder panels. A single physical tape per seat. No new original game.
split: Same 4 native held terrains as joint-response study plus 2 known pay-policy maps as separate recent holdout. Of 21 remaining older maps 4 with lowest SHA256('enemy-cal-v1|'+terrain) reserved only for probability calibration. The rest fit event heads. Original panel has one opponent registration: cross-registered-opponent evaluation exclusively in ladder panel, with map-, seat- and opponent-level metrics. All raw paths, split and archive hashes bound before labels. Registered distinct names do not certify independent code.
movement: Do not refit a new next-action policy. Reuse frozen tactical_rules/opponent_intent.json original visible-seat five-move model trained on policy_v0_5. Fit temperature only on four separate calibration maps, separately on no/yes 3-step progress toward home. Baselines raw head and repeated last visible displacement with 0.8 mass on the last direction and 0.05 on the other four (uniform if unavailable).
events: Every acting-seat predecision enemy collector carrying positive cargo, from step0 to the last actual call. Targets next intended physical direction even if later killed; same carrier positive receipt at its own base within the next 3/5 actual transitions; realized contested destination with an opposing positive-cargo collector within those 3/5 under both teams' actual orders. Encounter is not synonymous with winning or initiating a raid. Record actual transfer to this surviving carrier separately. Within-game horizons truncate at official terminal; no imagined future. Bank amount is actual cash at own base; may include later collection. No private opponent observation and no current orders enter predictive features.
features: Frozen opponent intent logits with own-seat visibility mask; public per-ID recent positions, cargo and home-distance change over 1/3/5/10, earlier strictly same-seat history, nearest hostile/supporting workers and cash, prior direction/return probabilities. Official actual enemy action enters offline labels only.
heads: For each 3/5 bank/contest target fit a distinct scaled L2 logistic regression C=1 on 17 original training maps. Each map equal total weight; no resampling positives. Platt calibration on four other maps, slope constrained nonnegative; monotone 5-step probability via max(p3,p5). References: training prevalence and home-distance/nearest-hostile-distance single-feature logistic. Evaluate raw and calibrated scores, map-level Brier and calibration bins/log loss, actual frequency, seat/player, intervals by map; no model selection.
action_check: Score only same-root fully signed pairs with attributable predicted cargo/vs foregone deposits, opposite side's forecast shared. Examine selected known full joint's actual first-step receipts and official terminal difference, all other roots keep parent; do not attribute hypothetical or third actions. Need both average actually collected own cash and official margin improvement on held maps to warrant any intervention. Leave model predictive-only if unproven. Do not start original games.
